tools.name: search_signnow_features
tools.description: Search signNow's eSignature product features by name or capability, for example "bulk send", "reusable templates" or "audit trail". Returns matching features with their description and page URL.

query.description: What to search for, for example "bulk send", "reusable templates" or "audit trail".

tools.name: search_signnow_form_templates
tools.description: Search signNow's library of ready-to-use PDF form templates by name or topic, for example "W-9", "lease agreement" or "medical release". Returns matching templates with their title, description and page URL.

query.description: What to search for, for example "W-9", "lease agreement" or "medical release".
